name: Daino's Arena
author: Daino Selvatico
description: An arena in a lava lake ringed by mountains, with challenges against Kalebo III's enemies (waves, bombs, flame vents, weapon limits, championships) and grind rails (a test rail, a course of three lanes with mines to jump and Kalebo III's rail mines to break, and an escape from the lava through a portal into another place).
